title: Topological Barriers in Geometric Complexity Theory: Milnor-Fiber Padding Collapse and the Exact Cohomology of the 3x3 Permanent
description: Unconditional proof of the Milnor-fiber padding collapse under affine padding (Perm_n(Z) + y^n) and the exact singular and compactly supported cohomology b(F_Perm3) = (1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 5, 6, 3, 1) of the 3x3 permanent Milnor fiber via an affine A^2-bundle and stratified Gysin/toric excision, accompanied by a symbolic and finite-field verification library.
